title: NovaCure plc Form 6-K Phase 3 data
bodyText:
UNITED STATES
FORM 6-K
Report of Foreign Private Issuer
NovaCure plc announced topline data from its Phase 3 clinical trial of NC-201 in relapsed oncology patients. The trial met its primary endpoint with statistically significant improvement in progression-free survival. The Company plans to submit a BLA to the FDA and noted a potential PDUFA target action date of December 18, 2026 if accepted for priority review.
